lines.trans: Marinochka, hello! We definitely need to talk calmly.
Eduard Valentinovich, what is there for us to talk about?
I was a foolish scoundrel, but everything changed.
I have finally left my wife Alla.
You did that completely in vain. Everything is over.
Marinochka, I beg you, marry me!
Look, I bought a real gold wedding ring!
Nothing will definitely work out between us.
Because I truly love another person.
Marina, he is a dangerous criminal and bribe-taker!
But with him I am happy for the first time in my life.
Marina, help me, my foot hurts!
Be a real man at last and go home.
